title: Campus Network Incident Response
description: Campus network failures affecting university operations
triggers: Network performance degradation affecting academic operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on university operations and academic activities
Notify Pioneer University IT Operations team
Implement emergency network bypass if available
Contact university administration for operational impact assessment
investigation_steps: Check network device status and logs
Verify network connectivity to campus facilities
Analyze network traffic patterns for anomalies
resolution_steps: Restart failed network devices following standard procedures
Implement redundant network paths if available
Apply network configuration fixes or rollbacks
Coordinate with network vendor for complex issues
verification: Test network connectivity to academic buildings
Confirm with university staff that network is operational
escalation_contacts: Escalation Group: Pioneer University IT Operations
special_considerations: Campus-wide outage or student/academic system unavailable is P1
During examination periods, LMS and identity incidents are automatically treated as P1
Academic operations are critical for university functions
Coordinate with academic departments for minimal disruption
